(GIRISH CHATNI)
 XXIX ACJM, BENGALURU  JUDGMENT The P.S.I., of H.A.L, Police Station, Bengaluru, has filed the present charge sheet against the accused for the offence punishable under sections Secs.498A, 324, 504, 506 of IPC.

BRIEF FACTS OF THE PROSECUTION CASE ARE AS UNDER :
It is the case of the complainant that, in the year 2004 CW.1 and accused got love marriage and thereafter the complainant went to her matrimonial house and led marital life with accused at No.333, Shivananda Nagar, 8 th Cross, Behind BEML Quarters, New Thippasandra.
It is further alleged that, the accused picked up quarrel with CW.1 for small issues and subjected her to cruelty by harassing her both physically and mentally.

It is further alleged that, on 23.05.2023 at about 4.00 PM,
accused abused CW.1 in filthy language and assaulted her with Iron Box on her head and caused blood injury and threatened her with dire consequences.

Based on the written complaint lodged by C.W.1, CW.8 has registered the case against accused in P.S. Crime No.212/2023 for the offence punishable under sections 498(a), 324, 504,
506 of IPC.
Investigating Officer/ CW.8 investigated the matter, after completion of the investigation has submitted final report against the accused for the above said offences.

3. Upon receipt of charge sheet, cognizance was taken for the above mentioned offence alleged against the accused and registered the criminal case against him.
C.C.No.53382/2024 4.
After registering the case, the accused has appeared before this court and enlarged on bail.
Copy of the final report and its' enclosures were furnished to him in compliance of section 207 of Cr.P.C.
Sufficient grounds were made out to frame charges.
Hence, charges framed and read over to the accused.
He pleaded not guilty and claimed to be tried.

sentences.text: In order to prove the guilt of the accused, the prosecution has examined one witness out of 08 witnesses cited in the charge sheet as P.W.1 and relied upon documents as per Ex.P.1 to Ex.P.5 and closed its side.

In lieu of absence of incriminating circumstances appearing against accused,
recording of his statement under section 313 of Cr.P.C. was dispensed with.
6. Heard both sides.
Perused the materials on record.

7. The points that arise for my consideration are;
1. Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable doubt that, CW.1 got married to accused in the year 2004, after the marriage CW-1 has led marital life at her matrimonial house and subsequently accused has physically C.C.No.53382/2024 and mentally subjected CW.1 to cruelty and thereby committed an offence punishable U/s.498A of IPC ?
2. Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable doubt that, on 23.05.2023 at about 04.00 PM, on the above mentioned place, accused abused CW.1 in filthy language and thereby committed an offence punishable U/s.504 of IPC ?
3.

Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable doubt that, on the above said date, time and place, accused assaulted CW.1 with iron Box on her head and caused blood injury and thereby committed an offence punishable U/s.324 of IPC ?

4. Whether the prosecution proves beyond all reasonable doubt that, on the above said date, time and place, accused threatened CW.1 with dire consequences and thereby committed an offence punishable U/s.506 of IPC ?
5. What Order?
C.C.No.53382/2024 8.

My findings on the above points are as under:
 Point Nos.1 to 4 : In the Negative.
 Point No.5 :

As per the final order  for the following;
 REASONS  9. POINT Nos.1 and 4 :-
As these four points are interlinked, I have taken up these points together for common discussion to avoid repetition of facts & evidence.
In order to bring home the guilt of the accused, the prosecution has examined the complainant/victim/C.W.1 as P.W.1 and relied upon five documents.

sentences.text:
In order to bring home the guilt of the accused, the prosecution has examined the complainant /
victim/ CW.1 as PW.1, wherein, the said witness has not supported the case of the prosecution.

The learned APP appearing for the State with permission treated the said witness as hostile and fully cross examined her, wherein, nothing has been elicited from the mouth of the PW.1 in order to prove the guilt of the accused.
. On perusal of the materials on record and the oral & documentary evidence of P.W.1, she has categorically admitted that, she has compromised the matter with the accused.

In view of the evidence of P.W.1, since the matter was compromised, the prayer of the learned Senior Asst. Public Prosecutor for issuance of witness summons to other witnesses was rejected as no purpose would be served.
As the P.W.1 has turned hostile to the case of the prosecution, the evidence on record is not at all helpful to substantiate the guilt of the accused.
Hence, there is no cogent and convincing evidence against the accused.
The bail bond of the accused shall be in force for the period of 6 months and C.C.No.53382/2024 thereafter it shall be cancelled without further orders.
(Dictated to the Stenographer directly on computer and typed by her, corrected by me and then signed and pronounced in the Open Court on this date the 07 th day of March, 2025.)
(GIRISH CHATNI) XXIX ACJM,
